vi_usefulness_distribution_before_filter.description: JSON object mapping VI usefulness codes (bits 2–5) to base-valid pixel counts; no usefulness threshold applied.

vi_usefulness_distribution_after_filter.description: JSON object mapping VI usefulness codes to quality-passing pixel counts.

x-dataset.spatial_grain: Exact Story County pixel-center mask; 37,193 county pixel centers

provenance.transformation: Byte-for-byte copy of an existing validated CSV; no aggregation, imputation, conversion, or rounding.

requirements: Exact ordered source columns and declared CSV types.
Unique, non-null natural key within the declared spatial scope.
Finite numeric values, declared ranges, exact coverage and missing counts.
Source and output records identical, including order, precision and null markers.
Source/output/schema SHA-256 values and manifest metadata agree.
Dataset-specific calendar, denominator, quality and unit-consistency checks.

warnings: Use exact Story County pixel-center summaries only (37,193 pixels), not historical AOI/bounding-box summaries.
Monthly statistics pool valid pixel observations; means are weighted by valid pixel counts. Months 2019-02 and 2021-01 have no valid statistics.
Eighteen 16-day dates have no quality-passing pixels. December 2025 ends at the available 2025-12-19 observation; no interpolation.
MODIS vegetation indices describe county greenness, not crop-specific stress or field observations.

x-csv.note: NULL and empty cells decode to JSON null only in nullable fields. Identifiers such as mukey stay strings. Units=null means not applicable or not separately verified.
